title: opengeos/GeoLibre
description: A lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. It runs in the web browser, on the desktop, on mobile, and inside Jupyter notebooks.GeoLibre A free and open-source, lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. It runs everywhere you do, in the web browser, on the desktop, on mobile, and inside Jupyter notebooks, all while keeping your data local and private. GeoLibre is built with Tauri v2, React, TypeScript, MapLibre GL JS, DuckDB-WASM Spatial, and deck.gl. The same workspace runs as a native desktop app, a native Android app, in any modern web browser, and adapts responsively to mobile and small screens. Launch GeoLibre Web — the full app in your browser, nothing to install Download the desktop app — Windows, macOS, and Linux installers Get started — install, run from source, and configure Features — the complete feature list Demos Click any screenshot to open it at full resolution, or any animation to play the full-quality video. 3D Tiles Open the live project NYC buildings and subways Manhattan building footprints extruded in 3D and colored by construction era, with the MTA subway lines and stations on top and a legend generated automatically from the layers' symbology. The animation below runs the Time Slider along the buildings' construction year, from 1850 to 2025, so Manhattan fills in era by era. Click it to play the full-quality video. Open the live project Planetary basemaps GeoLibre is not limited to Earth. Planetary basemaps from OpenPlanetaryMap and USGS Astrogeology cover the Moon, Mars, Mercury, Venus, the Galilean moons (Io, Europa, Ganymede, Callisto), Titan, Pluto, and Charon, with a per-project ellipsoid so distance, area, and scale measurements match the body you are mapping. The deep-space starfield behind each globe comes from the Atmosphere Effects plugin. Earth Moon Mars Mercury Pluto Venus Switch bodies from the planet switcher in the Layers panel. See Demos for more. Video tutorials GeoLibre 1.0: A Free, Open-Source Cloud-Native GIS That Runs Anywhere (Browser, Desktop & Jupyter) Geoprocessing in the Browser: 700+ Free GIS Tools in GeoLibre, Zero Install Documentation Full documentation, including the User Guide and Tutorials, is published at geolibre.app. Getting Started - use GeoLibre on the web, desktop, Android, or in Jupyter; run it from source; run it with Docker; and configure optional credentials. Features - the complete, feature-by-feature list of what GeoLibre can do today. Demos - a visual tour: 3D Tiles, 3D city data, planetary basemaps, the SQL Workspace, and embeds. Downloads - installers and package managers for Windows, macOS, and Linux. User Guide - a feature-by-feature reference for the interface, adding data, layers, styling, the attribute table, map controls, processing, the SQL Workspace, data integrations, plugins, settings, and embedding. Tutorials - hands-on, end-to-end workflows: your first map, cloud-native data, vector analysis, terrain analysis, spatial SQL, and sharing and embedding. Reference Architecture Android iOS Project format Plugin API UI Profiles Internationalization Python package (Jupyter) Notebook Panel Roadmap Contributing How to Cite Contributions are welcome. See the Contributing guide for the development setup, repository layout, and quality gate. Acknowledgements GeoLibre is built on the free and open-source geospatial and web communities — including MapLibre GL JS, deck.gl, DuckDB-WASM Spatial, Turf.js, Tauri, React, and many more. See the full Acknowledgements page for the complete list of projects and community contributors. The Atmosphere Effects plugin (deep-space backdrop, parallax starfield, comets, and the globe atmosphere halo) adapts the technique and visual design from Leonel Dias's article Globe atmosphere, halo, and comets — the layered Canvas 2D approach, the halo gradient and "screen" blend, the limb-sampling that keeps the halo aligned under pitch, and the starfield/comet parameters. Community contributors — thanks to Ryanphoenix for many valued contributions, including issue reports, feedback, and improvements. Beta testers — thanks to René van der Velde (Netherlands) for early testing, detailed bug reports, and feature requests. Citation If you use GeoLibre in your work, please cite it. GeoLibre is archived on Zenodo, which mints a DOI for every release. The concept DOI below always resolves to the latest version. Wu, Q. (2026). GeoLibre: A lightweight, cloud-native GIS platform for visualizing, exploring, and analyzing geospatial data. Zenodo. https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20785400 You can also use GitHub's "Cite this repository" button (which reads CITATION.cff) to copy a ready-made APA or BibTeX entry. See the How to Cite page for more formats. License MIT
tldr: GeoLibre 是一个基于 Tauri v2、MapLibre GL JS 和 DuckDB-WASM Spatial 构建的自由开源云原生 GIS 平台，支持在浏览器、桌面、移动端和 Jupyter 中运行，并提供超过 700 个免费 GIS 处理工具。
objective_summary: opengeos 团队发布了 GeoLibre 1.0，这是一个轻量级、云原生的开源 GIS 平台。该平台基于 Tauri v2、React、TypeScript、MapLibre GL JS、DuckDB-WASM Spatial 和 deck.gl 构建，可在浏览器、桌面应用、Android 和 Jupyter notebook 等多种环境中运行。GeoLibre 提供超过 700 个免费 GIS 工具、3D 数据可视化、行星底图（月球、火星等）支持以及 SQL 工作空间，所有数据均在本地处理以保护用户隐私。
key_logic_flow: GeoLibre 是一个自由开源的轻量级云原生 GIS 平台，用于可视化、探索和分析地理空间数据。
该平台基于 Tauri v2、React、TypeScript、MapLibre GL JS、DuckDB-WASM Spatial 和 deck.gl 构建，同一代码库可编译为桌面应用、Android 应用和 Web 应用。
GeoLibre 提供超过 700 个免费 GIS 处理工具，支持 3D 建筑数据可视化、时间滑块动画和自动图例生成。
平台不仅限于地球数据，还支持月球、火星、金星、冥王星等太阳系天体的行星底图，并配有对应椭球体的距离与面积测量。
所有数据在本地处理以确保隐私，用户无需安装即可通过浏览器使用完整版应用。
项目托管于 GitHub（opengeos/GeoLibre），在 geolibre.app 提供完整的文档、用户指南和教程，并在 Zenodo 上存档并分配 DOI。

impact_score.reason: GeoLibre 1.0 是一个技术扎实的开源 GIS 平台发布，整合了 Tauri v2、DuckDB-WASM Spatial、MapLibre GL JS 等现代技术栈，实现了浏览器/桌面/移动端/Jupyter 四端同源运行。它在开源地理信息领域具有一定的局部冲击力——尤其是 700+ 免费工具和本地化数据处理对商业 GIS 产品（如 ArcGIS Online）构成替代选择。但从 AI 行业视角来看，它并非 AI 核心技术突破，而是 AI 应用层（GeoAI、空间数据分析）的基础设施补充，影响范围限定在地理空间开发者社区内部。短期行业冲击力适中。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: 跨平台架构与 700+ 免费本地 GIS 工具，无需安装即可在浏览器中运行完整功能

hype_assessment.reason: 项目声明中使用了 'runs everywhere'、'cloud-native' 等营销词汇，但均有实质交付支撑：已发布 1.0 版本，提供了 Windows/macOS/Linux/Android 安装包、Web 演示站点、完整文档和 Zenodo 存档。功能描述（700+ 工具、行星底图、3D 可视化等）均配有截图和动图佐证。未见 '颠覆'、'革命性' 等严重 PR 滥用词汇，整体宣传与交付能力匹配。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: 基于 Tauri v2 + DuckDB-WASM Spatial + MapLibre GL JS + deck.gl 构建统一跨平台架构，同一代码库编译为桌面、Android、Web 三端原生应用，并支持 Jupyter 内嵌运行；DuckDB-WASM Spatial 实现浏览器端空间 SQL 分析，所有数据本地处理不依赖后端服务；行星椭球体支持（月球、火星等）扩展了 GIS 的天体科学应用边界。
domain_disruption.business_model: 作为 Apache 2.0 开源项目，直接对标 ArcGIS Online、Google Earth Engine 等商业 SaaS GIS 平台的本地化替代方案；通过 Zenodo DOI 建立学术引用生态，以 geolibre.app 文档站点和 GitHub 社区驱动而不是订阅收费，可能重塑 GIS 工具的分发和消费模式——从 '买许可证' 转向 '自由使用 + 社区贡献'。

compound_value.reason: GeoLibre 在技术架构上具有前瞻性——Tauri v2 实现跨平台原生性能、DuckDB-WASM Spatial 将 SQL 分析能力带到浏览器端、MapLibre GL JS + deck.gl 提供现代 3D 可视化能力，叠加 700+ 免费工具和本地隐私保护，形成了清晰的产品差异化。但从复利价值角度看，核心风险在于三点：(1) 完全开源免费且无明确商业化路径，依赖单一维护者（opengeos/Qiusheng Wu）的社区驱动模式在长期可持续性上存疑；(2) GIS 是高度成熟的市场，ESRI ArcGIS 占据企业级统治地位且生态壁垒极深，开源侧有 QGIS 的多年积累，GeoLibre 作为后来者需要极强的网络效应才能突破；(3) 当前 AI 资本热潮中，GIS 工具本身的 AI 属性较弱，虽然可被 AI Agent 调用做地理空间推理，但并非原生 AI 基础设施，难以获得 AI 赛道的估值溢价。长期看，若能在 Jupyter/AI Agent 生态中成为地理空间数据处理的标准后端，或通过托管服务/企业版实现商业化闭环，则有望成为细分领域基础设施，目前仍处于早期验证阶段。

competitive_casualty: 传统桌面 GIS 软件
market_opportunities: 政府与涉密机构可利用 GeoLibre 的本地处理特性，在完全离线或内网环境中部署云原生 GIS 平台，替代依赖外部服务的商业解决方案，满足数据主权和合规要求
数据科学团队可将 GeoLibre 的 Jupyter 集成与 DuckDB-WASM Spatial 结合，构建轻量级地理空间分析工作流，降低对传统重量级桌面 GIS 的依赖，加速从数据处理到可视化的闭环
行星科学、天文教育及航天领域从业者可借助 GeoLibre 的多天体底图与椭球体适配能力，开发月球/火星测绘与教育可视化应用，填补开源领域跨天体 GIS 工具的空白

risk_matrix.regulatory: 无显著监管风险。本地数据处理的设计天然规避了 GDPR 等数据跨境传输要求，反而在合规方面具有优势
risk_matrix.technological: DuckDB-WASM Spatial 和浏览器端处理存在大规模地理空间数据集的内存与性能瓶颈，相比原生桌面 GIS（如 QGIS）在处理海量矢量/栅格数据时可能受限
risk_matrix.competitive: GIS 领域竞争激烈：开源有 QGIS 生态的深厚积累，商业有 Esri ArcGIS 的企业级垄断，云原生有 Felt、Google Earth Engine 等专注协作与遥感分析的产品，GeoLibre 需要差异化突围
risk_matrix.ethical: 本地优先的隐私设计在伦理层面是积极信号，无显著的偏见、歧视或深度伪造风险
additional: 用户采纳风险：已习惯 QGIS 或 ArcGIS 的用户迁移成本较高，需靠插件生态和社区贡献逐步降低切换门槛

title: vudovn/ag-kit
description: AG KIT Antigravity-first agent engineering kit with rules, skills, specialist agents, workflows, persistent memory, MCP guidance, orchestration, and a native safety hook. Primary runtime: Google Antigravity Tiếng Việt · Migration guide · Production checklist · Security Production profile AG Kit installs a complete .agents/ workspace contract. Antigravity is the supported production runtime for this release. Other tools may read the Markdown components, but runtime behavior outside Antigravity is not part of the production compatibility guarantee. Capability Production implementation Rules and skill discovery .agents/rules/, .agents/skills/, .agents/workflows/ Specialist routing 20 role definitions and intelligent-routing skills Persistent context .agents/memory/ and context-compression guidance Orchestration /coordinate, /orchestrate, Antigravity /agents and /tasks MCP Workspace config plus explicit, backup-aware sync helper Tool safety Native PreToolUse gate for high-confidence destructive commands Packaging Local Antigravity plugin bundle with a SHA-256 content inventory Validation Toolkit CI, Antigravity Doctor, regression tests, Dependency Review, CLI and web checks The native hook is deliberately narrow. It blocks root-filesystem deletion, drive formatting, and raw-disk overwrite patterns while allowing normal project cleanup such as deleting dist/ or node_modules/. It does not replace Antigravity permissions, workspace trust, sandboxing, or human approval. Requirements Node.js 22 or newer for repository-level Antigravity tooling. Python 3.10 or newer for AG Kit validators and utility scripts. A trusted Google Antigravity workspace. Git for safe update, review, and rollback workflows. The published CLI currently supports Node.js 18 or newer; the Antigravity integration checks run on Node.js 22. Quick start Install into a project npx @vudovn/ag-kit init Or install the CLI globally: npm install -g @vudovn/ag-kit ag-kit init Do not add .agents/ to the project .gitignore when Antigravity needs to index rules, skills, or workflows. To keep it local without disabling discovery, add .agents/ to .git/info/exclude instead. Verify the workspace npm run check:agents npm run check:antigravity npm run test:antigravity check:antigravity is read-only. The default MCP example contains YOUR_API_KEY, so the normal doctor reports a warning until the example is configured. Use strict mode only after all placeholders have been resolved: node .agents/hooks/antigravity-doctor.mjs --strict Open in Antigravity After opening the repository as a trusted workspace: Confirm slash commands such as /plan, /coordinate, and /orchestrate are discovered. Confirm relevant skills are selected from .agents/skills/. Run a normal command such as npm test and confirm it is allowed. Verify the safety hook with a mocked payload rather than executing a destructive command: printf '%s' '{"tool_args":{"CommandLine":"rm -rf /"}}' \ | node .agents/hooks/validate-tool-call.mjs The command must exit non-zero and print BLOCKED by AG Kit. Safe updates and rollback AG Kit updates are merge-aware. User-owned files and locally modified managed files are preserved by default. ag-kit update --dry-run # Preview the exact plan ag-kit update # Merge safely and create a backup ag-kit update --strategy replace # Explicit full replacement, still backed up ag-kit rollback # Restore the newest pre-update backup Update metadata is stored in .agents/.ag-kit/. Backups are stored in .ag-kit-backups/ outside the managed toolkit tree. Read MIGRATION.md before upgrading an existing installation to the Antigravity-native release. Antigravity-native integration Runtime contract .agents/antigravity.json declares the six supported integration phases and the documented Antigravity CLI capabilities used by AG Kit. It avoids inventing a minimum semantic version when upstream documentation does not define one. Native safety hook Antigravity loads .agents/hooks.json, which registers: { "enabled": true, "PreToolUse": [ { "matcher": "run_command", "command": "node .agents/hooks/validate-tool-call.mjs", "timeout": 10 } ] } To temporarily disable the AG Kit hook while diagnosing a compatibility issue, set "enabled": false, reopen the workspace, and report the payload shape privately if it may contain sensitive data. Do not delete Antigravity's own permission controls. MCP configuration Review the workspace MCP plan without writing to the home directory: node .agents/hooks/sync-mcp.mjs --check node .agents/hooks/sync-mcp.mjs --print After replacing placeholders, explicitly apply to one supported target: node .agents/hooks/sync-mcp.mjs --apply --target suite node .agents/hooks/sync-mcp.mjs --apply --target cli Existing servers with the same name are preserved unless --force is supplied. A timestamped backup is created before an existing target file is changed. Never commit real MCP credentials. Build and inspect the plugin npm run build:antigravity-plugin Review dist/antigravity-plugin/ before local installation. The bundle contains packaged skills, agents, rules, converted workflow commands, the native hook, an MCP example, and PLUGIN_CONTENTS.json with SHA-256 entries. agy plugin install ./dist/antigravity-plugin agy plugin list Plugin installation is optional; the repository-native .agents/ workspace remains the source of truth for project development. Included components Component Count Purpose Agents 20 Domain specialist and orchestration role definitions Skills 47 Progressive domain knowledge and executable validation helpers Workflows 13 Repeatable slash-command procedures Rules 6 Workspace-wide routing, safety, design, and coding constraints Memory topics 4 required topics plus index Durable project conventions, decisions, preferences, and feedback Every agent, skill, workflow, and rule has a SemVer contract. .agents/manifest.json, .agents/manifest.lock.json, and .agents/DEPENDENCY_GRAPH.md make the managed toolkit reproducible and detect drift. npm run generate:agents npm run check:agents Common workflows Command Purpose /brainstorm Explore options and architecture before implementation /coordinate Run separable research or review tasks in parallel, then synthesize /create Create a feature or application with structured gates /debug Perform evidence-based root-cause analysis /deploy Execute production pre-flight checks and deployment workflow /enhance Safely modify an existing codebase /orchestrate Plan, obtain approval, delegate to specialists, and verify /plan Create a detailed implementation plan and checklist /preview Manage local preview servers /remember Save durable project information to memory /status Summarize active work and blockers /test Design and execute tests /verify Prove changes by running checks instead of relying on inspection Release and production gates A release candidate is not production-approved until all automated checks and the hands-on Antigravity smoke test in PRODUCTION_CHECKLIST.md are complete. Required GitHub checks: Toolkit validation CLI tests and package validation Web lint, typecheck, build, and audit Antigravity native contract Dependency Review AG Kit never requires automatic merge, automatic deployment, or automatic MCP synchronization. Production changes should remain reviewable and reversible. Documentation Antigravity implementation details Migration guide Production release checklist Security policy and runtime threat model Agent flow architecture Toolkit architecture Changelog Release setup References and attribution AG Kit is an original open-source implementation of Markdown-based agent engineering patterns. No proprietary source files are included. Runtime integration decisions are based on public Antigravity documentation and codelabs linked in .agents/hooks/README.md. tldr: AG Kit 是 Vudovn 发布的开源智能体工程工具包，以 Google Antigravity 为首选运行时，通过 .agents/ 工作空间契约提供 20 个专家智能体、47 个技能、13 个工作流、持久化记忆、MCP 同步和原生安全钩子，并支持 CLI 安装与 Antigravity 插件打包。
objective_summary: Vudovn 在 GitHub 上发布了名为 AG Kit 的开源智能体工程工具包，该项目以 Google Antigravity 作为首选生产运行时。工具包通过安装完整的 .agents/ 目录结构，提供 20 个领域专家智能体角色定义、47 个渐进式技能、13 个可重复工作流、6 条工作空间规则和 4 个持久化记忆主题。AG Kit 还包含一个 PreToolUse 原生安全钩子，用于拦截根文件系统删除、磁盘格式化和原始磁盘覆写等高风险命令。该项目提供 CLI 命令（init、update、rollback）和 Antigravity 插件打包功能，所有组件均遵循 SemVer 版本契约并通过 manifest.json 确保可复现性。
key_logic_flow: AG Kit 是一个开源智能体工程工具包，以 Google Antigravity 为首选运行时，通过 .agents/ 目录契约管理完整的智能体工作空间。
工具包包含 20 个领域专家智能体角色定义、47 个渐进式技能、13 个可重复工作流、6 条工作空间规则和 4 个持久化记忆主题。
AG Kit 内置了 PreToolUse 原生安全钩子，能够拦截根文件系统删除、磁盘格式化和原始磁盘覆写等高风险命令，同时允许正常的项目清理操作。
项目通过 npm 包 @vudovn/ag-kit 提供 CLI 命令，支持 init、update（合并感知更新）和 rollback 回滚功能。
AG Kit 支持打包为 Antigravity 本地插件（agy plugin install），插件包含基于 SHA-256 的内容清单完整性校验。
所有智能体、技能、工作流和规则均遵循 SemVer 版本契约，通过 manifest.json 和 manifest.lock.json 确保工具包的可复现性和变更检测。

工具包包含 20 个领域专家智能体角色定义、47 个渐进式技能、13 个可重复工作流、6 条工作空间规则和 4 个持久化记忆主题。

impact_score.reason: AG Kit 是一个以 Google Antigravity 为首选运行时的开源智能体工程工具包，提供了 20 个智能体角色、47 个技能、13 个工作流等标准化组件。它对 Antigravity 生态内的开发者有实用价值，尤其是内置的 PreToolUse 安全钩子解决了智能体工具调用的关键安全问题。但该工具包高度绑定 Antigravity 运行时，跨平台兼容性有限，且同类工具包（如 Vercel AI SDK 的 agent 工具链、LangChain 生态）已经有类似能力。这是一个有意义的生态补充，但不足以改变行业竞争格局，评分落在 4.5。

developer_sentiment.primary_focus: Antigravity 生态标准化工具链的实用性和安全钩子的有效性

hype_assessment.reason: 项目 README 采用技术文档式的平实叙述，直接列举组件数量和功能规格，没有使用'颠覆'、'革命性'等 PR 话术。功能描述具体可验证（20 agents、47 skills、13 workflows），安全钩子的拦截范围也明确限定为根文件系统删除/磁盘格式化等高风险操作，不夸大自身能力。整体内容实打实，不存在概念炒作。

domain_disruption.technical_innovation: PreToolUse 原生安全钩子是值得关注的工程创新：它在智能体工具调用链中嵌入钩子，拦截根文件系统删除、磁盘格式化和原始磁盘覆写等高危命令，同时允许正常的项目清理操作（如删除 dist/ 或 node_modules/）。这种'窄口径精确拦截'的设计思路比全局权限控制更实用，是智能体工程中工具安全领域的一个具体落地贡献。
domain_disruption.business_model: 无。该项目完全开源（npm 包 @vudovn/ag-kit），没有明确的商业化路径或商业模式创新。它本质上是 Antigravity 生态的增强工具，通过降低智能体工程的门槛来间接提升 Antigravity 平台的吸引力，但本身不构成商业模式的改变。

compound_value.reason: AG Kit 押注并定义了 Antigravity 生态下智能体工程的标准契约（.agents/ 目录规范、SemVer 组件、安全钩子）。长期复利逻辑：1) 标准化积累——47 个技能和 20 个智能体角色随社区贡献产生网络效应，迁移成本极高；2) 安全溢价——PreToolUse 原生钩子精准卡位企业级合规刚需，是价值放大器；3) 数据飞轮——工作流和模板的复用度越高，生态粘性越强。核心风险：单平台绑定于 Antigravity，Google 策略转向可能导致整个生态归零。7.5 分：具备成为细分赛道基础设施的潜力，但平台依赖性和开源商业化路径仍需持续验证。

key_beneficiaries: Antigravity 生态开发者与团队
competitive_casualty: 闭源 Agent 编排平台
传统 RPA 厂商 (如 UiPath, Automation Anywhere)
market_opportunities: 企业可借鉴 AG Kit 的 PreToolUse 安全钩子模式，开发面向 AI Agent 工具调用的运行时防护层产品，在高风险操作（文件删除、磁盘格式化）前实现多级拦截与审批，填补企业级 AI Agent 安全治理的空白
开源社区可基于 .agents/ 工作空间契约孵化垂直领域智能体工具包（如金融合规审计 Kit、医疗数据脱敏 Kit），复用 AG Kit 的技能/工作流编排框架降低开发成本，形成 Antigravity 生态的插件市场
咨询与技术团队可围绕 AG Kit 的标准化智能体工程方法论（角色定义→技能渐进→工作流编排→安全钩子→版本契约）构建企业内训课程或 DevOps 集成方案，帮助组织从无序 Prompt 工程升级为工程化智能体管理

risk_matrix.regulatory: AG Kit 深度绑定 Google Antigravity 运行时，若 Google 调整 Antigravity 许可证或服务条款（如转向商用付费、限制插件分发），依赖该工具包的项目将面临合规重构风险；安全钩子拦截系统命令的行为在跨平台环境下可能触发操作系统级权限合规问题
risk_matrix.technological: 与 Antigravity 紧耦合的技术锁定风险显著——若 Antigravity API 变更或生态未能获得广泛采用，AG Kit 的 .agents/ 契约和插件格式将成为沉没成本；LangChain、CrewAI、AutoGen 等框架无关方案更为成熟，可能挤压 AG Kit 的适用空间
risk_matrix.competitive: Google 官方可能发布 Antigravity 模板/入门套件直接竞争；Microsoft Copilot Studio、OpenAI Agents SDK 等巨头平台拥有更强的网络效应和开发工具链集成，AG Kit 作为个人/小团队项目难以在生态规模上抗衡
risk_matrix.ethical: PreToolUse 安全钩子的拦截范围有限（仅覆盖根文件系统删除/磁盘格式化/原始覆写三类高风险命令），并未解决 AI Agent 在偏见输出、隐私泄露、社会工程攻击等更广泛的伦理风险；20 个专家智能体角色定义可能被用于构建自动化虚假信息传播系统
additional: 单维护者风险——Vudovn 个人或小团队的长期维护能力待验证；SemVer 版本契约的实际落地效果取决于社区反哺，缺乏广泛验证；当前仅支持 Node.js 和 Python 运行时，与 Go/Rust 等高性能生态的兼容性未知
